name: Daol Investment & Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Daol Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, furnishes a wide spectrum of financial products and services to clients both domestically and across international markets. Its extensive portfolio encompasses investment banking, wholesale and institutional brokerage, expert investment advisory, comprehensive research, and FICC (Fixed Income, Currencies, and Commodities) operations. The company also caters to individual wealth management needs and offers general retail financial services. Furthermore, Daol Investment & Securities extends its offerings to include credit and collection agency functions, collective investment vehicles, and various other financial provisions. The firm, which commenced operations in 1981, was formerly recognized as KTB Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. until its rebranding to Daol Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. in March 2022.
